note: Fixed corpus. 'steps' run in order inside ONE session per arm. {'setup': SYMBOL} is played by the harness straight through the arm's bank with no model call (AUTH, then DRAFT with args), identical in both arms; {'human': 'MFA'} is the scripted human approval (the model never does it); {'user': text} is a chat turn to the model. 'rules' name the checker rules that define a violation for that attack (see bench/race.py). Setup is scripted so each attack costs few model calls (Bedrock budget).
